verdicts.quote: A freed spot goes to the first waiting member **automatically** (booked at once, member told). No offer/claim window
Order is first-come-first-served by the order the server commits joins | Priority tiers
no per-member limit on simultaneous waitlists, no overlap rule beyond the existing booking rules
verdicts.missing: What happens to a member's other waitlist entry for an overlapping class when one promotion books them; whether it is removed, skipped, or left waiting.

verdicts.quote: Studio wants no-show control, or existing late-cancel penalties make a surprise booking harmful
verdicts.missing: Whether a promoted member who cancels late or does not attend is charged under the existing no-show/late-cancel policy.

verdicts.quote: the first eligible waiting member is booked into that spot **as part of the same operation** (R-7)... promotion completes within the freeing operation (R-7e); only notice delivery is asynchronous
a notice is also sent through the existing notification channel where one exists (G-2). A failed notice never undoes a promotion.
Ana and Ben cancel simultaneously (either order): booked [Cy, Dee], waiting [Eli]; each promoted exactly once
SC-1.8: Cy (waiting) books C1 directly: refused `on_waitlist`.
Whatever the existing booking charges (credit, pass, payment) is applied at promotion, not at joining; a failed charge counts as ineligible.
No waitlist length cap and no "latest promotion time" cutoff. The list is bounded by one entry per member per class (R-1)
no "latest promotion time" cutoff... promotion can happen any time before the class's booking closes
raising a class's capacity promotes waiting members in order, one per new spot... Capacity lowered or unchanged: no promotion and no removal of anyone
when staff cancel a class, every waiting entry ends as `class_cancelled`, the members are told, and no booking is created for them.
Waitlist entry (new): class, member, join order, status... Positions are derived from a stored join order, not stored as mutable numbers.
When the booking-close instant passes, remaining entries end as `expired`... record kept as long as the existing booking records
other members' identities on a waitlist are never returned to a member
Members see their own position and the number waiting; staff waitlist viewing or editing is out of scope
verdicts.missing: Any staff view, manual promote/remove, or record of who was promoted when; the spec excludes these rather than specifying them.

verdicts.quote: if the feature is switched off after entries exist, entries stay unpromoted until the feature returns or they expire
verdicts.missing: Whether and how the feature is switched off, and whether it can be enabled per class or class type.

verdicts.quote: a promotion is visible on the first read after the cancel returns
A class with a free spot books exactly as before and shows no waitlist controls
Existing data: no migration or backfill; existing classes start with an empty waitlist; existing bookings are untouched.
